title: Parsing the Doubled Prefix
statement: Let $y,u,v,pre,a$ be binary words and suppose $y=pre\,\langle u,v\rangle$, where $\langle u,v\rangle$ is the encoding formed by doubling the bits of $u$, appending $01$, and then appending $v$. Starting from the comparator configuration in parser state at input position $|pre|+1$, with decoded work word $a$ and work head at position $|a|$, after $2|u|+2$ steps it is in rewind state at input position $|pre|+2|u|+3$, with decoded work word $a u$ and work head at position $|a u|-1$.
replaced: Suppose the comparator input has the form $y = p\,e$ where $e$ is the self-delimiting encoding of a pair $(u, v)$. From the parser state at position $|p|+1$ with decoded word $a$, exactly $2|u|+2$ steps of the pair comparator reach the rewind state at position $|p|+2|u|+3$ with decoded word $a\,u$.
